info.name: Ayez Ahlaq — Barber console (.exe + mobile)
info.description:
Every endpoint the barber console needs — the desktop `.exe` and the barber mobile app share this exact surface. No admin endpoints.

**Client type is mandatory.** Every request (login included) must send `X-Client: DESKTOP` or `X-Client: MOBILE` — set the `client` collection variable once. Login bakes that value into the JWT as a `client` claim; every later call must resend the SAME `X-Client` header or it is rejected (401 mismatch / 400 missing).

Auth: phone number + password. Only the shop **owner** logs in (team members are records only for now). `Auth > Login` stores `token` + `barberId` as collection variables.

Phone: `01001234567` / `+201001234567` / `201001234567` all work.

Base URL: production `https://gobeeeg.com/ayezAhlaqApi`; local `http://localhost:8082`.

variable.description: DESKTOP | MOBILE — must be identical on login and every request after it

request.description: `X-Client` header is REQUIRED (400 without it). Response `data` = { token, role: "BARBER", actorId, displayName, client }. The token carries a `client` claim = the header value; every request below must send the same `X-Client`.

No auth, no X-Client. Creates the barber (shop owner) + their shop in one call and signs them in immediately: 201 with { activated:true, auth:{token,...} } - the token already carries client=MOBILE, so send X-Client: MOBILE on every call afterwards. shopName is required; area/address/latitude/longitude optional (set later via PUT /api/barber/location). Duplicate active phone -> 409. If the phone belonged to a self-deleted barber, you instead get { activated:false, otpTtlSeconds, devOtp } and must call verifyOtp below - the same shop/history is revived. devOtp is only present in dev (otp.expose-in-response).

item.name: Register - verify OTP (reactivate a deleted account)

request.description: Only for the activated:false path. Correct OTP -> 200 { token,... } and the old account (shop, bookings, ratings) is back. Wrong/expired/too-many-attempts -> 400.
Only needed when reviving a previously self-deleted account (register then returns {activated:false, devOtp}); a brand-new phone is logged in immediately. Returns the full AuthResponse (the token).
Fresh 6-digit code (TTL 300s), attempt counter reset, previous code dead. 400 if there is no pending / un-verified signup for that number.
{ expiresInSeconds, devOtp }. Works for a barber owner AND a team member. No X-Client needed even for barber.
{ resetToken (opaque, TTL 600s), expiresInSeconds }.
Third and final step. 400 on a bad / expired reset token.
min 6 chars; wrong currentPassword -> 400. Barber: X-Client required (bare /api/{role}/password, not the /password/ prefix).

id, name, phoneNumber (local 0…), shopId, shopName, owner, active, mustChangePassword, rating, ratingCount, latitude, longitude, address, client. Also carries `owner` and `servesClients` — servesClients=false means the owner is an investor who does not take clients: they are hidden from the customer booking flow, the slot engine and the queue, and they free an employee-cap slot.
The barber pins their own geo-location. All three fields optional — send null to clear. Returns the updated profile.
Verifies the current password (401 if wrong), sets the new one (min 6), and clears `mustChangePassword`. Use the temp password the admin gave on first login.

item.name: Set servesClients (owner works on clients or not)

request.description: OWNER ONLY. `{"value": false}` marks the shop owner as an investor who does not serve clients — they disappear from the customer booking flow, the slot engine and the queue, and an employee-cap slot frees up. `true` puts them back on the floor. A team member calling this gets 403 'أعضاء الفريق يديرهم صاحب المحل'. Read the current value from `servesClients` on GET /api/barber.

item.name: Documents
item.description: GET /api/barber/attachment rows carry reviewStatus (null/PENDING/APPROVED/NEEDS_ACTION), reviewNote, reviewedAt. While the shop has an unmet required document, GET /api/barber returns documentsPending:true + statusMessage + pendingDocuments[], and EVERY write 403s except /attachment/**, /password, /deviceToken, /notification.

request.description: Each item: id, name, required, createdByType, hasFile, originalFileName, contentType, sizeBytes, uploadedByType, uploadedAt, createdAt.
multipart/form-data, field `file`. Images or PDF only, 15 MB max. Replaces any file already in the slot.
Returns the raw file bytes with the original filename.

item.name: Delete a document file (keep the slot)

request.description: Clears the uploaded file. The slot itself stays — only the admin can add or remove slots.

item.name: Services & prices
item.description: The barber picks which global service types the shop offers and sets price (EGP) + duration (min) for each. GET /catalog = active types not offered yet.

request.description: [{ serviceTypeId, name, description }] — active types the barber does not offer yet
[{ id, serviceTypeId, name, description, price, durationMinutes, popular, active }]
price>=0, durationMinutes>=1. 409 if already offered. 404 if the serviceType is missing/inactive.
Change price / duration / popular. active optional.
Deletes the offering row. Future bookings snapshot price/duration so history is unaffected.

item.name: Working hours
item.description: Weekly schedule. dayOfWeek 0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday. GET returns all 7 days (a day with no row = off). PUT upserts the whole week; a working day needs opensAt < closesAt ("HH:mm").

request.description: [{ dayOfWeek, off, opensAt, closesAt }] x7
Send all 7 days. off=true clears the times. 400 if a working day is missing a time or opensAt >= closesAt.

item.name: Store & orders
item.description: The barber buys supplies from a merchant (product owner_type=MERCHANT). Browse merchants -> their products -> quote (with discounts) -> place order. The order lands in the merchant inbox as PENDING.

request.description: [{ id, businessName, phoneNumber, rating, ratingCount, productCount }] — active merchants
[{ id, name, brand, categoryName, price, effectivePrice, minOrderQty, hasImage }]
Inline image bytes for a merchant product. Falls back own image -> category image -> global default; 404 if none of those exist.

fulfillmentType is optional (DELIVERY | PICKUP_AT_BRANCH). With DELIVERY the response adds deliveryFee + grandTotal from the merchant's delivery settings (0 when the merchant does not offer delivery or the goods total reaches their free-delivery threshold).
fulfillmentType DELIVERY is rejected (400) when the merchant does not offer delivery. The order snapshots deliveryFee; GET order responses expose deliveryFee + grandTotal (= total + deliveryFee).
[{ id, code, status, merchantId, merchantName, fulfillmentType, note, rejectionReason, total, orderDiscount, orderDate, ..., items }]
Only while PENDING (400 otherwise).

item.name: Team & earnings
item.description: Read-only barber-console insights, aggregated from bookings (status DONE).

request.description: Every active barber in the caller's shop, ranked by clientsThisMonth (then rating, then name). Each: id, name, owner, you, rating, ratingCount, clientsToday, clientsThisMonth, rank.

today / last7Days / thisMonth service revenue (SUM total_price of DONE bookings) + matching client counts, avgTicket (thisMonth/clientsThisMonth), supplierSpendThisMonth (committed product-order value bought this month), netThisMonth (thisMonth - supplierSpend), and dailyLast7 [{date, amount, clients}].

The admin-managed numbers you transfer the money TO (InstaPay / Vodafone Cash / …). Returns active ones only: [{ id, type, mobileNumber, label }]. Show these as a dropdown on the DEPOSIT screen — the user picks one, you send its id as transferAccountId below.

formdata.description: REQUIRED for DEPOSIT **and WITHDRAW** — the id of the chosen transfer account (from GET /transferAccount), i.e. the InstaPay / Vodafone Cash method. Missing → 400, inactive/unknown id → 400.
Optional — ONE image or PDF, ≤ 15 MB (transfer screenshot / bank slip).

request.description: multipart/form-data. Creates a PENDING request. One pending per owner at a time (409). **transferAccountId is required for BOTH DEPOSIT and WITHDRAW** — it is the admin-managed InstaPay / Vodafone Cash account from GET /transferAccount, and it is what tells the admin which method to use. On WITHDRAW put the merchant's own receiving number in `note`. WITHDRAW is capped at the wallet's available balance. The admin approves (credits/debits the wallet) or rejects with a reason; you get a notification.

Whole-replace all lists. drinks = the shop DRINK MENU ({drinkId,quantity}). addons = storefront products ({productId,quantity}) — legacy, still accepted. adjustments = free-form {label, amount} lines (amount may be negative). total_price = base + style_delta + Σ(drinks+addons) + Σ adjustments. 409 once the booking is DONE / NO_SHOW / CANCELLED. The view returns adjustments[], adjustmentsTotal, billingLocked; every addons[] entry carries drinkId (null for a product line).

CONFIRMED walk-in — for someone with NO account who just showed up (no customer row / OTP; name+phone are free-text labels only). barberId is REQUIRED — which barber in the shop will serve them (get the list from GET /api/barber/team); missing → 400. The owner may pick any shop barber; a team member may only pass their own id (else 403), and that barber must offer the service (else 400). customerName / customerPhone optional. slotTime ("14:30") optional — omit → 'now'; the queue resequences by slot time. drinks:[{drinkId,quantity}] optional; the old addons:[{productId,quantity}] path still works.

Sends a notification to customers. scope: ALL (every customer) | MINE (your own customers — favourited or booked). NOT sent immediately — it enters the admin approval queue as status=PENDING (recipientCount 0, no quota spent). The admin may edit the title/body, then approve (quota is spent + delivered) or reject with a reason. You get a notification either way (type broadcast_approved / broadcast_rejected).
